::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 19th 1886  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_743.qmd)[^1]

I am very sorry if I did not answer your letter, and acknowledge the little book, I fully thought that I had done so.

I have gone quite half way in the [Life of Hannah More](cmy_books/cmybook_199.qmd). If the requisite number of pages be not attained, I can easily shorten or lengthen the account of her works, but I think the length will be right.

I have the [Mendip annals](other_books/otherbook_1019.qmd) - i.e. Patty More’s Journal, which I find very useful

Yours truly
C M Yonge		

I think I shall be able to send you the whole MS in less than a month

---

[^1]: John Henry Ingram (1842-1916) was editor of the ‘Eminent Women’ series for which CMY wrote *Hannah More*.
